releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.1.0 - Decoded Audio Waveforms, Shareable Lyric Cards, Multi-Select Library & Hi-Res Telemetry
releaseNotes: Introduces real-time decoded audio PCM waveform scrub bars with peak amplitude extraction and dynamic album palette tinting, 1080px shareable lyric card generator with 4 curated card themes, comprehensive multi-select library management with batch Delete, Add to Playlist, Add to Queue, and Share actions, persistent Hi-Res audio stream telemetry badge, and precision A-B repeat practice looper.
